newsitem.title: USA: Gardner Denver revs raised by acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Gardner Denver revs raised by acquisitions.

text.p: Gardner Denver Machinery Inc said Wednesday its first quarter earnings rose in the wake of acquisitions that helped improve revenues.
The company, which provides air compressor and blower products for industrial applications, posted net income of $5.3 million, or $0.51 a share, versus $3.9 million, or $0.39 a share, a year ago.

Revenues increased to $66.1 million from $48.6 million, thanks in part to the acquisitons of NORAMPTCO Inc and TCM Investments Inc last August, Gardner Denver said. The two units contributed about $14.5 million to revenues in the first quarter.
Gardner Denver shares were up 2-5/8 at 22-7/8.
